title: [finding] ADR-0076 OQ#9's D11 worklist records outcomes for items (1)(2)(3) but never for (4) — the env-resolution seam landed and the ADR does not say so
body:
Filed unassigned by the dev seat on #9024 (session `session_011RB4waLuNbdruCo6X9oobm`) while re-deriving figures for the ADR-0076 D11 revision — PR #9057. Out of that card's scope, so recorded here rather than ridden along. Searched open and closed issues by keyword and by ADR/file path first; the near neighbour is #2462 (the OQ#9 audit itself, closed), no duplicate.

## The observation

`docs/adr/0076-objectql-core-tiering.md` Open Question 9 sets a four-item D11 worklist:

> D11 worklist: (1) kill or delegate the dead callable branches; (2) give packages + discovery a single owner; (3) extract per-domain handlers; (4) unify env-resolution on the injected `KernelResolver` seam.

Three of the four have their outcome recorded under that entry — **(2) shipped**, **(1) re-scoped**, then **(1)+(3) VERDICT (2026-07-27, #2462 series)** absorbing (1) into (3). **Item (4) is never mentioned again**, in OQ#9 or anywhere else in the ADR.

## Measured against `origin/main` @ `dc280d326`

Item (4) looks landed, which is what makes the silence worth recording rather than shrugging at:

- `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts:145` declares `interface KernelResolver`, and the dispatcher holds one (`private kernelResolver?: KernelResolver`, resolved from `options.kernelResolver` or the `kernel-resolver` service).
- The constructor's old environment-registry parameter is explicitly retired in favour of it:

```
 * @param _envRegistryIgnored — RETIRED (ADR-0006 Phase 5). Environment
 * resolution moved behind the host's {@link KernelResolver}; the
 * positional parameter is kept so existing 3-arg callers keep compiling,
 * but its value is ignored.
```

- `packages/runtime/src/domain-handler-registry.ts` reads the same seam for the direct-caller kernel swap.

So the seam exists, env resolution went behind it, and it is attributed to **ADR-0006 Phase 5** in the source — while ADR-0076, which asked for it as D11 worklist item (4), records nothing.

## Why this is worth a card rather than nothing

An unrecorded worklist item reads identically to an unmet one. This is the same defect class #9024 was filed for one level down: D11's rest-server half was a decision that existed only in an issue thread, so the ADR kept reading as an open obligation and the next calibration round would have re-litigated it. Item (4) is the cheaper version — the work landed, and the only artefact that asked for it does not know.

## Not asserted here

⛔ Whether item (4) is *fully* discharged by the ADR-0006 Phase 5 seam, or only partly. I measured that the seam exists and owns env resolution in the dispatcher; I did not audit every env-resolution call site against what OQ#9 meant by "unify". Whoever takes this should settle that before writing a status line — an ADR status line asserting more than was measured is the failure mode, not the fix.

⛔ Not a defect in behaviour: nothing here is broken at runtime. Observation class, hence `finding` and no `pm:queue`.

Related: #2462 (the OQ#9 audit that produced the worklist) · #9024 / PR #9057 (the D11 revision, where this was noticed) · ADR-0006 Phase 5 (the seam's recorded owner in source).
